sections.title: 8. Accreditation and recognition of civil engineering in France**

items: **In France, accreditation** Civil engineering is important when comparing a bachelor's program with an engineering-school diploma.

The ****Commission des titres d’ingénieurs (CTI)**** evaluates qualifying engineering programs and authorizes institutions to award the French *diplôme d’ingénieur* It is a different qualification, a three-year bachelor’s degree.
Students should: Pre-enrolment
* Check what qualification will be granted.
* **CTI accreditation** if they want a French engineering degree.
* The qualification must be suitable for further education.
* Check any requirements for professional registration or recognition in the country they intend to work.

sections.title: 9. Salary and Job Opportunities after Civil Engineering UG in France**

items: ****Civil engineering graduates in France**** can find jobs in construction, infrastructure, consultancy, transport, building design and project delivery. Your career options are dependent on your qualification, technical skills, work experience, language proficiency and work authorization.
Possible career paths include:
* **Civil engineer by graduation.**
* Junior Structural Design Engineer**
* **Site or building engineer.**
*  CAD or BIM Technician.**
* Quantity surveyor or cost-estimation assistant.**
* Engineer of transport infrastructure.**
* Assistant for geotechnical engineering.
* Project planning or coordination specialist
* Water & environmental infrastructure specialist.**
**Salary expectations** Salaries differ depending on job title, location, employer, qualification and experience.

sections.title: 11. Civil Engineering Undergraduate in France: FAQs**

items: **Q1. Is it possible for Indian students to study Undergraduate Civil Engineering in France?**
Yes. **Indian students can do civil engineering in France** if they meet academic, language and application criteria, by applying to eligible bachelor’s and engineering-school courses.
**Q2. How long is the civil engineering bachelor's degree in France?**
A **civil engineering bachelor’s degree** is usually a three-year program. A traditional ** French engineering-school track ** is usually five years post-high school .
**Q3. Are courses in civil engineering in France taught in English?**

Many of the traditional civil engineering engineering-school curricula are taught in French. There are some modules or exchange options taught in English, but students should verify that the entire degree is taught in English.
**Q4. What is the cost of studying Civil Engineering undergraduate in France?

Depends on the institution. For the academic year **2026-2027**, the published differentiated fee for non-EU students governed by the rules of the relevant public institution is **€2,902 per year at bachelor level**. Fee schedules can differ from engineering school to engineering school.
